Back to school: 95 kits for a good start

Backpacks, notebooks, pencils and calculators: thanks to you, children started school with their heads held high.

For a child, arriving on the first day without supplies means starting the year with a weight on the heart.

This summer we prepared 95 school kits [sample figure]: a backpack, notebooks, pencils, a calculator and a short note of encouragement.

And after the first day?

Our education programme continues all year with volunteer homework help [to confirm]. Love passing on what you know? Join the team.
